83 likes, 1 comments - 91mobiles on October 7, 2026: "Apple Vision Pro has some serious competition! 👀

Meet the Vivo Vision Discovery Edition. It’s significantly lighter than Apple’s headset and impresses with:

🎬 120-foot virtual theater screen
🌐 360-degree environment 
👓 8K Dual micro-OLED displays
⚡ Snapdragon XR2+ Gen 2 Chipset

We are still waiting on the official India price drop, but you can experience it live right now at 15 different Vivo experience zones nationwide.

Are you team Apple or team Vivo on this one? 👇

#vivovisiondiscovery #vivovision #vr #smartgadgets".
